verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is a US/Canada immigration law firm, so documenting the International Entrepreneur Rule parole pathway is a fair question to ask of it. Its investors-and-entrepreneurs pages only invite contact about "various options" and describe a J-1 university incubator program and Canada's Start-Up Visa. Nothing in the evidence mentions the International Entrepreneur Rule, entrepreneur parole, or any qualifying-investment thresholds.
